text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon received a fan letter, 
seemingly from a child.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Did you see, Trainer-kun?! They said, "My 
dream is to run like Tachyon"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even though she isn't an Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Admiration, is it...? Heheh. Don't you 
find that amusing, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To aspire to possess running legs on par 
with an Umamusume often described as 
mystical!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, utterly reckless! But that's 
precisely what makes it so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Very well, very well. Why don't I write a 
reply right away?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To a child with such an impossibly 
difficult dream!

Later on, I delivered the letter to the 
mailbox. I had caught a brief glimpse of 
it that day, and written there was—

'If you want the leg strength of an Uma 
Musume, you just have to research. I look 
forward to your future results.'

It was written in a slightly bouncy, 
cheerful handwriting.
